name: Layer Agent
description: Creates a LayerAgent that frames a single panel layer (edge beams, studs, sheathing plate, panel boundary). Right-click to choose the agent type; its parameters appear as additional inputs.

inputParameters.name: layer
inputParameters.description: Layer (or its layer path) this agent frames, e.g. from CT_Decompose_LayerStructure.

inputParameters.name: internal_joint_overrides
inputParameters.description: List of joint rules between elements of this agent. Rules matching a default (same topology and categories) replace it; others are added.

inputParameters.name: external_joint_overrides
inputParameters.description: List of joint rules between elements of this agent and those of other agents. Rules matching a default (same topology and categories) replace it; others are added.

outputParameters.name: Agent
outputParameters.description: Configured LayerAgent. Connect to CT_PanelPopulator's 'agents' input.
